Cricket Player Vaibhav Suryavanshi's Performance Under Scrutiny

Batsman Vaibhav Suryavanshi's recent performance, particularly his struggles after hitting consecutive boundaries, has drawn attention. In a match, after hitting four consecutive boundaries, he was dismissed. This pattern of inconsistency, where a strong start is followed by a collapse, has been noted. Suryavanshi has previously performed well at the Harare ground.
